_comment: Shot list for a native-resolution recording (record.py, 2880x1800). 'target' and 'hide' are pixels in the recording: read them off a grid frame from review.py grid. Zoom stays at or below recording width / output width (2880/1920 = 1.5) so nothing is upscaled. For a Cursorful export the zooms are already in the picture: leave out target and zoom.

shots.caption: Connected to your accounting book
shots.say: This is the invoice app, connected to your accounting book.

shots.caption: Pick the bill
shots.say: You pick the bill out of your folder.

shots.caption: It reads every line
shots.say: Open it, and the app reads every line for you.

shots.caption: Every line coded to your chart
shots.say: Each line is coded to a real account from your chart, and you can change any of them.

shots.caption: In your book, as a draft
shots.say: And there it is in your book, sitting as a draft for you to approve.
